reason: I already have an Instagram page I order from and I know they deliver. This is a new name with no reviews I can see, and paying 21,000 in fees on 30,000 shoes is a lot of my money to risk on someone I don't know yet.
objection: What if the item comes wrong size or fake and they say it's 'as ordered'? No change-of-mind returns means if Taobao sizing is off I'm stuck with it, and I already paid the item price up front.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real customers from Baghdad posting their unboxings and the warehouse photos on Instagram, with a friend or someone I follow saying they got their refund when something was wrong.
